name: Umami Analytics
project_description:
Adds the Umami Analytics web statistics tracking system to your website.

 Basic tracking is implemented and is working fine.

 Branch 1.x is D9 compatible and will receive no new features, new work will continue in 2.x branch which is D10/D11 compatible.

 TODO 
 The next steps required to complete a fully functional basic version are:

 
 Implement all tracker configuration options https://umami.is/docs/tracker-configuration 
 Cron implementation of local js cache 
 Tests 
 Support custom tracker events
